content: Dr. Mike Reed, DC, DACBSP, CCSP, CSCS, is a licensed Doctor of Chiropractic who has dedicated several years to serving the United States Olympic Committee. He played a significant role in providing chiropractic care to the US Team during the 2008 Summer Olympic Games in Beijing, China, where he was entrusted with additional responsibilities in his field. Furthermore, he served as the Medical Director for Team USA during the 2010 Winter Olympic Games in Vancouver. Since 2007, Dr. Reed has held the position of Medical Director in the Sports Performance Division of the US Olympic Committee. Prior to this, from 2004 to 2007, he served as a faculty member and the Director of the Sports Medicine Residency Division at the Southern California University of Health Sciences.
